scope: Reference-based route definitions. The rules are original project instructions, not official model prompts.

source_ref_notes.xiaohongshu_pages: One-based slideshow page numbers actually reviewed. Canonical note URLs omit access tokens.
source_ref_notes.official_pages: Empty pages arrays indicate a web article, not a paginated slideshow; media_urls point to the reviewed effect examples.

validation_note: All 11 selectable routes have actual generated outputs and reference/aesthetic reviews: 15 versions, 15 pairs, and 11 selected comparison results. Eight art routes are candidates with explicit defects, surreal collage remains an experimental material mismatch, postage is a layout draft that did not preserve the inner photograph, and airy film is not verified as strict color-only processing. Each route used one input image only; selection is not full brief acceptance, stable cross-subject validation, user acceptance, or equivalence to an official model. The 15 unchanged upper-panel checks do not establish lower-panel fidelity.

crayon-vignette.name: 蜡笔小幅插画
crayon-vignette.material: Dry wax-crayon marks and a fine broken contour on warm paper.
rules: Redraw the selected source subjects with thin, slightly irregular outlines and overlapping wax-crayon strokes.
Let small gaps in the color reveal the paper grain; retain recognizable contours and a few useful interior details.
Keep the number, relative placement, orientation, and identifying colors of the selected subjects.
Reduce the setting to a short, muted color band derived from the input and leave generous paper space around the vignette.
Use the source palette at a softer saturation; keep faces, paws, handles, and other small structures coherent.
Create only the effect panel; the existing composition tool must place the unmodified source above it.
avoid: Photographic imagery with a texture overlay only
Thick oil-paint ridges or smooth vector fills
Torn-paper layers dominating the drawing
Invented objects, text, dates, stars, or hearts
crayon-vignette.validation_note: 选中 v2：纸面留白、灰绿短横带和蜡笔擦涂改善；主体仍偏大，中央失焦花痕未清除，未通过全部计划约束。 每条路线仅一个输入，分数与结论是助手主观视觉复核，未作用户验收或跨题材稳定性验证。

doodle-outline.name: 彩色轮廓涂鸦
doodle-outline.material: Sparse rounded colored strokes with mostly unfilled interiors.
rules: Describe the main subject using a small set of uneven, rounded colored lines rather than large filled shapes.
Keep most interior areas the color of the paper, with small solid accents only where the source needs them.
Preserve the silhouette, pose, ear or hair shape, and distinctive clothing or accessory colors.
For an animal, keep the muzzle, eyes, nose, limbs, and visible coat-color boundaries consistent with the input.
Leave open paper around the drawing; retain the same number of subjects and do not add decorative symbols unless requested.
avoid: Uniform mechanical vector outlines
Dense crayon shading over every surface
Generic replacement of the source subject
Unrequested captions, hearts, stars, or extra accessories
doodle-outline.evidence_limits: One reviewed page supports this route; broader subject coverage is untested.
doodle-outline.validation_note: 选中首版：彩线轮廓与主体关系成立；线条更接近精细植物线稿，与参考的圆头粗线涂鸦仍有差别。 每条路线仅一个输入，分数与结论是助手主观视觉复核，未作用户验收或跨题材稳定性验证。

clay-miniature.name: 手塑黏土微缩
clay-miniature.material: Matte hand-shaped clay with shallow tool marks and uneven painted color.
rules: Rebuild the selected subject as a small solid clay sculpture while preserving its pose, silhouette, and identifying color pattern.
Show shallow dents, pressed edges, and restrained tool marks that follow the form instead of random image noise.
Keep the surface matte and tactile, with painted colors following the source markings.
Use soft light and a coherent contact shadow to convey volume on a simple warm background.
Keep eyes and other small identity cues readable without changing their color or relative placement.
Do not add a display base, plaque, props, or lettering unless they are already in the source or explicitly requested.
avoid: Flat paper cutout
Glossy plastic toy surfaces
Fuzzy wool replacing the clay texture
Extra limbs, changed coat markings, invented pedestals or stamps
clay-miniature.evidence_limits: Reviewed evidence includes one cat photo pair and sampled wedding-figurine video frames. The video completes unseen legs and adds a base; these additions are not allowed by default. Animation is not validated.
clay-miniature.validation_note: 选中首版：手塑体积与七座塔可辨；位置略有重整，黄暖色偏重，局部接近石膏，不能视作严格结构保真。 每条路线仅一个输入，分数与结论是助手主观视觉复核，未作用户验收或跨题材稳定性验证。

surreal-photo-collage.name: 超现实摄影拼贴
surreal-photo-collage.material: Photographic cutouts, restrained paper grain, and a flat colored background.
rules: Use this route only when the user has allowed a change to scene composition.
Keep the cutouts photographic, with recognizable source detail and crisp but slightly imperfect cut edges.
Reposition or suspend only elements already present in the supplied photo or other explicitly supplied references.
Preserve the identity and count of people, animals, and major objects even when their spatial arrangement changes.
Use a restricted background color and optional grayscale cutouts to separate the layers clearly.
Do not invent floating rocks, buildings, scenery, or support objects to imitate a reference; omit them when the source does not contain them.
Treat any drawn orbit or accent line as an optional graphic decoration, disabled unless requested.
avoid: Silently applying this route to a request for faithful scene preservation
Borrowing buildings or scenery from an unrelated reference
Unrequested floating islands or extra props
Calling the edited composition a faithful record of the original scene
surreal-photo-collage.evidence_limits: The reviewed pages show finished collages without an untouched same-page source comparison.
surreal-photo-collage.validation_note: 选中 v3 作为实验性候选：灰阶黄底、留白与中央花痕清理改善；叶片仍像银灰浅浮雕，未达到摄影薄剪贴材质，不作为参考匹配通过的示范。 每条路线仅一个输入，分数与结论是助手主观视觉复核，未作用户验收或跨题材稳定性验证。

anime-scenic.name: 暖光动漫转绘
anime-scenic.material: Clean digital linework, simplified painted planes, and soft atmospheric color.
rules: Redraw the photo as a clean two-dimensional animated scene with simplified edges and coherent light and shadow.
Preserve the main silhouettes, horizon, viewpoint, object count, and spatial relationships.
Translate fine surface detail into a smaller number of readable painted shapes.
Use restrained warm highlights and cooler shadows derived from the source; a strong sunset shift requires an explicit request.
Keep water, architecture, and vegetation structurally readable instead of replacing them with generic scenery.
Generate no characters, landmarks, captions, or other objects that are absent from the input.
avoid: Photographic detail with only a color filter
Replacing buildings with generic fantasy structures
Adding glowing objects or changing the time of day without request
Losing subject count in bright highlights
anime-scenic.validation_note: 选中首版：二维线条、色面及山湖轮廓成立；岩壁色面偏碎且密，属于一次候选，未验证其他题材。 每条路线仅一个输入，分数与结论是助手主观视觉复核，未作用户验收或跨题材稳定性验证。

citypop-poster.name: City Pop 复古插画
citypop-poster.material: Dark contour lines, hard-edged color planes, and fine printed grain.
rules: Retain the source layout while simplifying shapes into crisp illustrated planes with dark blue or near-black contour lines.
Organize the palette around a limited set of cool blues and warm pink or coral accents, adapting their balance to the input.
Use defined shadow shapes and restrained gradients in broad sky areas.
Add fine, even print grain without obscuring edges and small identifying structures.
Keep the existing vehicles, architecture, and people; do not add palm trees, cars, signs, or a different skyline.
Omit invented lettering and logo-like graphics; any required source text must be checked separately.
avoid: Neon photographic filter without redrawing
Unrequested nighttime conversion
Generic retro scenery replacing the source
Unreadable invented typography or extra vehicles
citypop-poster.validation_note: 选中首版：描边、硬边色面与印刷颗粒成立，七个塔尖保留；整体更偏蓝橙白昼旅行版画，颗粒密度和暖色面积偏大。 每条路线仅一个输入，分数与结论是助手主观视觉复核，未作用户验收或跨题材稳定性验证。

knitted-miniature.name: 针织毛绒微缩
knitted-miniature.material: Small wool loops, wrapped yarn, and restrained felted fibers.
rules: Reconstruct the existing scene as a miniature made from knitted yarn and felted wool.
Make stitch and loop direction follow each surface so the material explains the form.
Keep the silhouette, floor or roof count, major openings, and relative placement of the source subjects.
Use small loose fibers at edges while keeping windows, limbs, and other structural details distinct.
Use soft light and moderate depth of field to establish miniature scale; retain the main color relationships.
Do not add clouds, plants, buildings, bases, or other scene objects solely because they appear in a style reference.
avoid: Blur used as a substitute for visible fibers
Overlarge stitches swallowing structural details
Flat fuzzy texture pasted on a photo
Extra miniature props or incorrect building levels
knitted-miniature.validation_note: 选中首版：针织走向随山、水结构变化；更接近立体壁毯，天空织纹较密，瀑布更粗，未达到参考的柔软微缩景深。 每条路线仅一个输入，分数与结论是助手主观视觉复核，未作用户验收或跨题材稳定性验证。

toy-brick-scene.name: 塑料积木场景
toy-brick-scene.material: Rigid modular plastic pieces with studs, seams, and localized highlights.
rules: Rebuild the source objects as a coherent three-dimensional construction of interlocking plastic blocks.
Use a consistent module scale, readable seams, studs, stepped curves, and contact shadows.
Preserve the object count, major silhouette, viewpoint, layout, and identifying colors.
For people, simplify to toy proportions while retaining clothing colors and pose; do not promise facial identity fidelity.
Keep plastic highlights local to the shape and separate adjacent pieces clearly.
Do not add brands, signage, accessories, or additional figures; check any requested text independently.
avoid: Two-dimensional pixel mosaic presented as physical blocks
Randomly sized modules
Glossy blobs with no seams or studs
Invented logos, extra figures, or unsupported text accuracy claims
toy-brick-scene.validation_note: 选中首版：实体积木、接缝与凸点成立；部分台阶和坡面重排，微小游客数量未可靠对应，也未证明实际可拼装。 每条路线仅一个输入，分数与结论是助手主观视觉复核，未作用户验收或跨题材稳定性验证。

postage-stamp-layout.name: 邮票明信片版式
postage-stamp-layout.material: Photographic clipping inside a perforated border on a warm paper field.
rules: Treat this as a layout treatment for a photograph, not as a new painting material.
Keep the source photographic and place its selected region inside a clean perforated stamp-shaped frame.
Preserve the identifying subject and avoid cropping a face or main building unintentionally.
Use a warm paper background with restrained grain and generous empty space.
A complementary negative-cutout panel is optional; it must not replace the unmodified original in the upper comparison panel.
Leave dates, places, postal denominations, and captions absent unless the user supplies them; decorative cancellation lines are optional.
avoid: Invented travel dates or locations
Claiming a processed panel is the original photo
Copying source slogans or postal text
Counting a layout variant as a new painting material
postage-stamp-layout.evidence_limits: One reviewed page with two processed layouts; neither panel is an untouched source image.
postage-stamp-layout.validation_note: 选中首版作为版式草图：齿孔、纸面和摄影窗口成立；内嵌照片被改写且未完整保留，严格仅加框要求不通过，正式保真版式应使用确定性排版。 每条路线仅一个输入，分数与结论是助手主观视觉复核，未作用户验收或跨题材稳定性验证。

airy-film.name: 清新胶片调色
airy-film.material: Fine photographic grain with soft contrast and restrained color shifts.
rules: Apply a photographic color grade while preserving geometry, identity, scene contents, and source text.
Lift midtones moderately and soften harsh contrast without flattening the image.
Keep highlights creamy and shadows slightly cool, while protecting natural skin color.
Retain local warm accents and keep the principal source color relationships readable.
Add fine grain evenly, preserving useful detail in white clothing, sky, and dark hair.
Do not redraw objects, replace backgrounds, or introduce a new light source.
avoid: Changing scene geometry
White highlights clipped into blank areas
Strong cyan skin
Plastic skin smoothing or painterly texture
airy-film.validation_note: 选中首版作为胶片观感候选：柔和反差与细颗粒成立，色彩偏暖；花瓣和叶缘有重新清晰化，尚未证明只改色彩和颗粒、几何未重绘。 每条路线仅一个输入，分数与结论是助手主观视觉复核，未作用户验收或跨题材稳定性验证。

pixel-stretch.name: 像素拉伸彩带
pixel-stretch.material: One broad curving ribbon built from dense, continuous parallel color lines over an otherwise photographic scene.
rules: Use this route only when adding an abstract ribbon has been authorized through allow-recompose.
Keep the source photographic, including its viewpoint, lighting, main silhouettes, positions, and object count.
Add exactly one broad ribbon whose palette is sampled from the selected source subject.
Specify the ribbon root near the chosen subject, with a coherent overlap or partial occlusion; route it through available open space and let its end leave the frame.
Make many fine parallel lines flow continuously along the curved surface, with natural changes in width and perspective.
Keep important faces and building outlines readable and avoid covering the visual anchor of the source.
Do not replace the ribbon with a few thin strands, motion blur, smoke, mosaic squares, or a glowing trail; do not add physical props.
avoid: Running without permission to add the abstract effect
Warping the whole photograph or the source subject
Multiple unrelated ribbons or new physical objects
Sparse string bundles, smoke, glowing trails, grid mosaics, or extra text
pixel-stretch.evidence_limits: Still frames at decoded PTS show the treatment; motion consistency and generation quality have not been validated.
pixel-stretch.validation_note: 选中 v2：彩带根部藏于塔肩后，下垂尾段已移除；平行线仍偏粗亮、略像金属丝带，摄影底图细节和微小游客保留未严格验证。 每条路线仅一个输入，分数与结论是助手主观视觉复核，未作用户验收或跨题材稳定性验证。

deferred.name: 写实远山背景
deferred.reason: Reviewed examples replace a portrait background with photographic mountains; they do not establish an ink-painting style.

deferred.name: 超现实色块环境重构
deferred.reason: The video replaces a complex photographed environment with large colored walls and simplified space. This is distinct from the retained static floating photographic-cutout route.
constraints: Agree which people and buildings must remain before removing background content.
Do not present the result as preservation of every original object or scene detail.

generation_summary.does_not_establish: Strict brief acceptance for all routes, lower-panel pixel preservation, cross-subject stability, user acceptance, or a measured success rate.
